commits_data.title: Change frame.time_epoch to FT_ABSOLUTE_TIME
commits_data.message:
Change frame.time_epoch to FT_ABSOLUTE_TIME

frame.time_epoch is exactly the same field as frame.time,
just using a different representation.

It was added as FT_RELATIVE_TIME because only relative
time types had support for Unix time. Now that that is
fixed, change the field type of frame.time_epoch to
FT_ABSOLUTE_TIME.

This means the field is represented differently in ek
but that's OK, the value is the same.

commits_data.title: Add Unix time support for absolute time field type
commits_data.message:
Add Unix time support for absolute time field type

Add ABSOLUTE_TIME_UNIX absolute time type, to allow
date and time values to be represented in Unix time,
besides other existing formats.

commits_data.title: dfilter: Add some arithmetic to FT_ABSOLUTE_TIME
commits_data.message:
dfilter: Add some arithmetic to FT_ABSOLUTE_TIME

FT_ABSOLUTE_TIME Hhas the same arithmetic properties as
FT_RELATIVE_TIME. Give it the same methods.

commits_data.title: wsutil: Add nstime representation in ISO8601 and Unix time
commits_data.message:
wsutil: Add nstime representation in ISO8601 and Unix time

Move some utility functions to wsutil/to_str.c.

Add interfaces to convert nstime to string representation in
ISO8601 and Unix time.

Use it in epan/print.c.
